run_image_encoder_inference: run TIPS image encoder inference on an image file with a specified model variant and checkpoint path
run_low_res_inference: run TIPS image encoder inference on a 224px low-resolution image with model variant S
run_giant_model_inference: run TIPSv2 image encoder inference with the giant model variant and swiglu feed-forward layer
run_inference_with_custom_image: run image encoder inference on a custom image file to extract normalized CLS token embeddings
run_multi_variant_inference: run TIPS image encoder inference across model variants S, B, L, So400m, and g with configurable image size
